title: Stage 8 — Production Environment Validation & Release Gate
head: 92d3d5b
summary: Production-environment validation of the LifeXP release candidate. The repository, clean-checkout reproduction, isolated-DB schema, migrations, seed idempotency, real backend startup matrix, full auth/user journey, social E2E, messaging/SSE E2E, security checks, and resilience/performance sanity all PASS. One new real defect was found and fixed (malformed UUID in :id params -> 500 instead of 400, same class as BUG-4). Live AI (no GROQ_API_KEY), live object storage (no sidecar), live production/staging PostgreSQL (no DATABASE_URL), and browser E2E (no browser) remain BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED, holding the verdict at YELLOW.

environment_reset_notice.recovery: All Stage 3-7 work was confirmed intact on the remote at c38fb68 (139 files). Recovered with git reset --hard c38fb68 after user confirmation. Nothing lost.

isolated_db_reproduction.migration_safety: PASS (applied from zero with no manual SQL; no destructive operations)

security_findings.description: 10 routes in social.ts and quests.ts passed unvalidated :id params to PostgreSQL -> 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' -> 500. Same class as BUG-4 (fixed only for conversations).
security_findings.fix: Added shared isValidUuid() (lib/uuid.ts) and guarded all affected routes -> 400.
security_findings.evidence: Live: DELETE /posts/not-a-uuid -> 500 before, 400 after; regression test uuid-validation.test.ts (10 cases).

security_checks_pass: SQL injection (parameterized queries; injected email/tag handled safely)
IDOR / cross-user access (posts, conversations, quests, profiles)
CORS allow-list enforced (allowed origin ACAO present; disallowed origin no ACAO)
rate limiting active (auth max 10/15min, refresh max 30/15min)
no user enumeration (identical response for unknown email vs wrong password)

performance_sanity.conversations_list_unbounded: LOW (user's own conversations, naturally small; no pagination)
performance_sanity.n_plus_one: NONE OBSERVED (bounded queries, Promise.all over <=3 bounded queries)
